brute.label: Sleeping cave troll six grids away
brute.explanation: A level-15 Warrior at full hit points (177) with 10 armour sees a sleeping cave troll six grids east. The production ranged-attack scorer rates a bolt at it. Original: the partial melee danger of the troll is 0 (a 5% hit chance), so the check that avoids waking a hard sleeping monster does not trigger and the bolt scores 12. Corrected: every blow's hit chance reaches the 100% cap, so the partial melee danger is 162, equal to the full-damage danger and well above half the Borg's avoidance (88), and the scorer refuses the attack. In both runs the partial estimate does not exceed the full-damage figure.
